description: This PHP class defines the entity 'OAuthAccessToken' used in the OAuth2 authentication process, representing access token data stored in the database with ORM mapping. It includes properties for token details such as access token string, client ID, user ID, expiry time, and revoked status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth 2.0 access token with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the access token record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the access token record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry time of the token as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry time of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
